description: This Java source file defines a generic class 'OperationResult' used as a response object in a management service, encapsulating status, payload, cache directives, and resource version information. It provides methods for creating different types of responses and integrates with messaging and caching utilities.

classes.name: OperationResult
classes.description: A final class representing an operation response with optional resource version and methods to create responses.

methods.name: getResourceVersion
methods.description: Returns the optional resource version associated with the operation result.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage response based on the request and a payload mapper, incorporating the resource version if present.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Factory method to create an 'OK' operation result with specified status, payload, cache directive, and resource version.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Factory method to create an empty response with a given status.
